svg.title: How vLLM caps max_tokens
svg.desc: max_model_len is the smaller of --max-model-len and the model context length, and holds the prompt and the generated tokens together. The room left after the prompt, max_model_len minus input_length, is the upper bound. With no limit in the request, max_tokens fills that room. A smaller request leaves the rest unused. A larger request is cut at the end of the context window.
